basic_profile.bio: I'm a 33-year-old gamer from Seattle, Washington, who works as a software developer. I'm passionate about open-world RPGs like Assassin's Creed and love discussing game strategies and sharing tips with the community. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy binge-watching anime, especially series like Kill La Kill, and listening to podcasts while brewing coffee on my Keurig. I'm currently single and typically online during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My gaming knowledge stems from years of playing and engaging with gaming communities online. I'm self-taught in game mechanics and enjoy exploring game design and development forums.
